import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MaxSize = 202;
    static final int Infinite = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[][] EdgeFlow = new int[MaxSize][MaxSize];
    static int[][] EdgeCap = new int[MaxSize][MaxSize];
    static int[] Parent = new int[MaxSize];
    static int[] Q = new int[MaxSize];
    static int[] Dist = new int[MaxSize];

    static int FF_Algorithm(int Nodes, int S, int T) {
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(Parent, -1);
            Dist[S] = Infinite;
            int h = 0, t = 0;
            Q[t++] = S;
            while (h < t && Parent[T] < 0) {
                int u = Q[h++];
                for (int v = 0; v < Nodes; ++v) {
                    if (Parent[v] < 0) {
                        int rc = EdgeCap[u][v] - EdgeFlow[u][v];
                        if (rc > 0) {
                            Parent[Q[t++] = v] = u;
                            Dist[v] = Math.min(Dist[u], rc);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (Parent[T] < 0) break;
            int delta = Dist[T];
            for (int cur = T; cur != S; cur = Parent[cur]) {
                EdgeFlow[Parent[cur]][cur] += delta;
                EdgeFlow[cur][Parent[cur]] -= delta;
            }
        }
        int sum = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < Nodes; ++k) sum += EdgeFlow[S][k];
        return sum;
    }

    static char[][] GridIn = new char[11][11];
    static char[][] GridOut = new char[11][11];
    static int Zr, Zc;
    static int[] DRow = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[] DCol = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[][] DistGrid = new int[101][101];
    static int N, Tval;
    static List<Integer> SRows = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> SCols = new ArrayList<>();

    static void BFS(int sr, int sc, int[] out, boolean condCheck) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        out[sr * N + sc] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0];
            int c = cell[1];
            int idx = r * N + c;
            int d = out[idx];
            if (condCheck && (DistGrid[Zr * N + Zc][idx] <= d || Tval <= d)) {
                if (DistGrid[Zr * N + Zc][idx] < d || Tval < d)
                    out[idx] = Infinite + 1;
                continue;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + DRow[i], nc = c + DCol[i];
                if (nr < 0 || nc < 0 || nr == N || nc == N) continue;
                char ch = GridOut[nr][nc];
                if (ch < '0' || ch > '9') continue;
                int nidx = nr * N + nc;
                if (out[nidx] != Infinite) continue;
                out[nidx] = d + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    static void BuildGraph() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char c = GridOut[i][j];
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    SRows.add(i);
                    SCols.add(j);
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    EdgeCap[idx + 2 + N * N][1] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        int zIdx = Zr * N + Zc;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char c = GridIn[i][j];
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    EdgeCap[0][idx + 2] = c - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < SRows.size(); ++k) {
                        int r = SRows.get(k), cc = SCols.get(k);
                        int qidx = r * N + c;
                        if (DistGrid[idx][qidx] < Infinite)
                            EdgeCap[idx + 2][qidx + 2 + N * N] = Infinite;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        Tval = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            GridIn[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            GridOut[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 101; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(DistGrid[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (GridIn[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Zr = i;
                    Zc = j;
                }
            }
        }
        BFS(Zr, Zc, DistGrid[Zr * N + Zc], false);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (GridIn[i][j] >= '1' && GridIn[i][j] <= '9') {
                    BFS(i, j, DistGrid[i * N + j], true);
                }
            }
        }
        BuildGraph();
        System.out.println(FF_Algorithm(2 + N * N + N * N, 0, 1));
    }
}
